messages:
anya: Quick check — small-batch long-seq sweep (EU-H100) shows a p95 bump when Q8 + FlashAttention v3 are enabled. Chart: https://redwood.internal/bench/2770003456 :thinking_face:
trent: saw a similar bump in APAC but only for seq_len > 2048. Might be packing or kernel threshold kicking in.
sam: can you paste the exact job config? batch_size, microbatch, seq_len buckets, model, kernel flags?
anya: here —
```
model: redwood-14b-open
batch_size: 2
micro_batch: 1
max_seq: [512,1024,2048,4096]
quant: q8_m
kernels: {flashv3: enabled, triton: enabled, vendor: auto}
triton_version: 2.19.0
flashv3: 3.0.1
vendor_lib: cuBLAS 12.3
region: eu-west-1
```
kayla: fwiw vendor libs (cuBLAS/cuDNN/oneAPI) tend to keep higher throughput for very long sequences but exhibit heavier tails (p99). Flashv3 often wins p50/p90 for tiny batches.
trent: agree. We should validate kernel switch thresholds by seq bucket. Suggest disable flashv3 for seq>1024 as a probe. We have an internal flag `kernels.override_per_seq` we can use.
sam: ran a quick AB locally — disabling flashv3 for seq>=2048 dropped p95 by ~20ms but throughput dropped ~6% for high-seq streams. So it's a tradeoff.
ops-bot: deploy manifest applied to canary (10% EU) by @sam — rollout id r-2026-03-kernel-probe — https://deploys.redwood/r-2026-03-kernel-probe :rocket:
anya: we also need KV-cache warmup traces + batching queue histograms. I suspect batching heuristics interact with kernel choice. Also check quantization path: q8_m vs q8_h may pick different kernels.
kai: note — jemalloc arena settings changed on the infra side last week; saw small payload p50 jitter. Could compound this.
sam: plan of action:
- run microbench per kernel (flashv2/v3, triton, vendor) across seq buckets [256,512,1024,2048,4096]
- capture p50/p90/p95/p99 + throughput + flakiness counts
- run eval prompts (real user prompts) to measure quality delta for q8 variants
- add hysteresis: require consecutive 3-window improvement before switchover
- canary rollout 10% EU then 5% global if stable
anyA: ack — I'll create a runbook and attach the raw csvs. tagging @tracing-team for flamegraphs and KV cache traces.
trent: also capture exact versions: Triton 2.19.0 -> 2.20.0 changes kernel selection heuristics, flashv3 3.0.1 -> 3.1.0 has a packing fix. Include vendor lib versions (cuBLAS 12.3, oneAPI 2025.1) in the benchmark metadata.
anya: putting this into a short postmortem-style note after runs. will DM when csvs are up. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
